recipes.name: Gulpea: Afghan Tomato & Cauliflower Stew
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium pot over high heat. Cook the onion, stirring often, until golden.
Add the tomato paste and turmeric, and stir continuously for 30 - 60 seconds to lightly toast.
Then add the remaining ingredients, cover, bring to a boil, and reduce to a gentle simmer, stirring every few minutes until water has been absorbed.
The dish is ready when the cauliflower is soft. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days.
